# Cheapflights

> > Cheapflights is a comprehensive flight comparison and booking platform that helps travelers find the best deals on airline tickets worldwide.

Cheapflights aggregates airfare prices from hundreds of airlines and travel sites to help users compare and book cheap flights to destinations across the globe. The platform specializes in finding budget-friendly flight options, including domestic and international routes, with a focus on popular destinations like Las Vegas, Hawaii, London, and Thailand.

## Key Topics

- Flight search and comparison
- Cheap flights and airline tickets
- Travel deals and airfare booking
- Budget airlines
- Popular destinations: Las Vegas, Hawaii, Florida, London
- International travel: Philippines, Costa Rica, India, Mexico, Italy, Australia
- Domestic US routes: Miami, Orlando, Chicago, Puerto Rico
- Southeast Asia flights: Bangkok to Phuket
- Flight price tracking
- Multi-airline comparison
- Discount airfare finder
- Last-minute flight deals
- Round-trip and one-way flights
- Flight booking tools
- Travel planning resources
